fields.summary_ko.0: Apple (AAPL -1.90%) rose 29% in 2026 and represents 25% of Berkshire Hathaway's public stock portfolio, with Warren Buffett not selling a single share in Q3.
fields.summary_ko.1: Despite Apple's P/E ratio approaching approximately 40, Berkshire Hathaway maintains its holding stance, reflecting its long-term investment philosophy of infinite holding periods.
